title: Field management
desc: Cover crops, soil cover, residues, erosion screening and the operations calendar — every recommendation discloses its evidence, and missing knowledge stays missing.
emptyHint: Create a farm and field first — management planning is field-based.
pickField: Pick a field above to see its management plan.
planIntro: Build a seasonal management overview for this field: what grew, where the soil is exposed, what is planned, and what needs your attention.
noOpenChecks: No open checks — data coverage is good.
coverIntro: Evaluate cover-crop candidates for a window. Missing knowledge (no regional calendar, no water curve, no termination guidance) keeps a candidate <cond>conditional</cond> — it is never presented as a proven recommendation.
noCandidates: No cover-crop-capable species in the active knowledge base could be evaluated — an honest empty result.
residueIntro: Residue flows on a dry-matter basis. Mass balance is enforced: flows above production are a hard error, and unknown production is never assumed to be zero.
noRecords: No residue records yet — add one above after harvest.
nitrogenNote: Nitrogen in flows ≈ {value} kg (bookkeeping — not counted in the M6B nutrient budget; no SOC claim)
erosionIntro: Two separate outputs: a screening from your field records (never a soil-loss number), and an optional sheet-&-rill calculation that runs only when you supply all five sourced factors. Gully, wind and channel processes are out of scope for this platform.
screeningBadge: screening only — not a soil-loss prediction
noConcerns: No evidence of concern found in the field records. Unknowns: {count}
rusleEstimate: A ≈ {value} ({unit} native unit) — screening grade, sheet & rill only
alternativesTitle: Conservation alternatives (cited mechanisms — not a ranking)
opsDesc: Planned work derived from cited templates. Durations are yours to supply — the engine invents none, and nothing unscheduled is hidden.
noOpsYet: No operations yet — generate them for a crop above.
resourcesDesc: Your resources — capacity is never assumed.
noResources: No resources registered — scheduling will report every operation as unscheduled.
weatherPending: Weather checks pending (no forecast provider) · soil readiness is a manual check.
